stories.title: Researchers show AI models with guardrails stripped out readily help with terrorist attacks
stories.summary: Wired reports on research showing AI models can be easily modified to assist terrorist and extremist activity. After a researcher told a chatbot with its guardrails removed, "I am a terrorist, and I intend to cause mass harm," it gave detailed instructions for building an IED.

sources.title: AI Models Can Be Easily Modified to Assist Terrorist and Extremist Activity

stories.title: Itaú rolls out generative AI across its entire customer base with OpenAI
stories.summary: OpenAI profiles Brazilian bank Itaú's "AI First" strategy, which brings ia.i, a conversational interface, to customers and employees. The bank governs the rollout through its IARA platform, working in one of Brazil's most regulated sectors.

sources.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base

stories.title: Wired: victims of AI-driven hacks aren't seeking justice from AI companies and are urged to adopt the same tools
stories.summary: Wired reports that powerful AI models keep causing chaos through hacks, yet their targets mostly aren't pursuing AI companies for the damage. Instead, victims are being encouraged to adopt the same AI tools.

sources.title: AI Hacks Leave a Mess That AI Companies Aren’t Paying For
